note: Sparse mirror of the open-licensed real-data inputs of builder/system_response/real/build_real.py, laid out like GB_REAL_DATA_DIR (.context/real_data). 'copy' files are byte-identical to the originals; 'slice' files keep only the rows the builder uses (rule given). Inputs marked mirror 'none' in real_sources.py (NESO .docx documentation, the derived communications timeline whose post text is not openly licensed) are not copied; with this mirror the builder skips only the quote checks that need them. No report PDF and no NESO website document is copied. Written by builder/system_response/real/sync_raw.py.
